text: The change moves the unchanged nsMsgBodyHandler2 class declaration into nsMsgBodyHandler.h, removes the textual .cpp include from nsMsgBodyHandler.cpp, gives nsMsgBodyHandler2.cpp its own header includes and lists it in UNIFIED_SOURCES. The accepted source retains that boundary. This establishes source/build registration, not a fresh compile/link result or unchanged runtime behavior, and it does not create a global rule against all .cpp inclusion.
title: The nested MIME parser moves to a header declaration and an explicit build entry
